contracts.allowed_paths: ["read-only source, contract, evidence; daemon role events only"]
contracts.forbidden_paths: ["production source edits", "direct SQLite writes", "out-of-scope changes", "fabricated task, identity, lease, capability", "product tests or builds or internet in this static planning task", "accept without independent PASS and valid lease"]
contracts.commands: ["daemon-compiled role prompt and independent verification", "supported role handoff via daemon"]
contracts.acceptance_checks: ["Exact approved TP-03 card and common contract", "No UNKNOWN, missing evidence or scope violations", "No static planning PASS represented as product PASS"]
contracts.required_evidence: ["source_baseline.json and task-scoped run manifest", "positive and negative validator outputs, rc and hashes", "owned diff and independent review record"]
